description: Free. The pump.fun coins whose bonding curve completed (graduated): the last hour as they land (from since), or a whole UTC day of the last three with day. Each with the seconds from its launch (same_second: bought whole in its launch second) and, for a day, the deployer's record before it. For: what just graduated on pump.fun, how many graduated today, which coins graduated in the same second. Then check_coin on a mint.

day.description: a UTC day YYYY-MM-DD of the last three, for the whole day instead

since.description: unix seconds in the last hour; graduations from it on. Left out (and no day): the last ten minutes

name: graduations
